scenario: Discussing a news story with a colleague
frequency_note: words ranked ~700–1500 by frequency of Portuguese

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Você viu a notícia sobre o novo plano do governo?
dialogue.translation: Did you see the news about the government's new plan?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Vi, mas ainda não entendi qual é a principal medida que eles querem tomar.
dialogue.translation: I saw it, but I still haven't understood what the main measure they want to take is.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Eles querem aumentar os impostos, portanto acho que vão reduzir os gastos públicos.
dialogue.translation: They want to raise taxes, so I think they will reduce public spending.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: É provável que isso ajude a economia, mas talvez precise de mais tempo para ver resultados.
dialogue.translation: It's likely that this will help the economy, but maybe it needs more time to see results.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Eu acho que a gente precisa de uma solução mais rápida.
dialogue.translation: I think we need a faster solution.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Sim, mas o governo diz que é a única forma de reduzir o déficit.
dialogue.translation: Yes, but the government says it's the only way to reduce the deficit.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Então, ainda temos que esperar e ver o que acontece.
dialogue.translation: So, we still have to wait and see what happens.

scenario: Negotiating a minor disagreement
frequency_note: words ranked ~700–1500 by frequency of Portuguese

vocabulary.note: Often used in phrases like 'de acordo' (in agreement) or 'chegar a um acordo' (to reach an agreement).
Used both literally (side) and figuratively (point of view).
Connects ideas; often used to propose a solution.
Common discourse marker for conclusions or suggestions.
Slightly more formal than 'mas', often after a comma.
Used for opposition or physical contact.
Regular -ar verb; can be followed by infinitive or noun.
In context, 'deixar de' means to stop doing something.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Eu entendo o seu lado, porém acho que precisamos de um acordo rápido.
dialogue.translation: I understand your side, however I think we need a quick agreement.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Não é um problema grande, mas acho que você não está considerando o meu ponto de vista.
dialogue.translation: It's not a big problem, but I think you're not considering my point of view.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Tem razão, mas para mim é importante resolver isso hoje.
dialogue.translation: You're right, but for me it's important to resolve this today.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Então, que tal fazermos assim: eu aceito a sua ideia, e você deixa de insistir no horário.
dialogue.translation: So, how about we do it this way: I accept your idea, and you stop insisting on the schedule.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Concordo, mas só se você também concordar em começar mais cedo amanhã.
dialogue.translation: I agree, but only if you also agree to start earlier tomorrow.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Tudo bem, mas não vou fazer nada contra as minhas convicções.
dialogue.translation: Alright, but I won't do anything against my convictions.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Perfeito, então temos um acordo.
dialogue.translation: Perfect, then we have an agreement.

scenario: Giving feedback on someone's work
frequency_note: words ranked ~700–1500 by frequency of Portuguese

vocabulary.note: often used with the subjunctive (e.g., 'talvez seja')

vocabulary.translation: to notice, to realize, to understand

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Li o seu relatório. A primeira parte está muito boa, mas acho que podemos melhorar a conclusão.
dialogue.translation: I read your report. The first part is very good, but I think we can improve the conclusion.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Entendi. Há algum ponto específico que devo mudar?
dialogue.translation: I understand. Is there a specific point I should change?

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Sim. A ideia principal está clara, mas talvez pudesses dar um exemplo concreto para ilustrar melhor o que queres dizer.
dialogue.translation: Yes. The main idea is clear, but maybe you could give a concrete example to better illustrate what you mean.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Faz sentido. Durante a pesquisa, encontrei alguns dados, mas não tinha a certeza de como os incluir.
dialogue.translation: That makes sense. During the research, I found some data, but I wasn't sure how to include it.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Exatamente. Percebo a tua dúvida, mas acho que esse dado seria um bom exemplo para o teu argumento.
dialogue.translation: Exactly. I understand your doubt, but I think that data would be a good example for your argument.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Obrigado pelo conselho. Vou tentar reescrever essa parte com mais detalhe.
dialogue.translation: Thanks for the advice. I'll try to rewrite that part with more detail.

scenario: Explaining a problem to customer service
frequency_note: words ranked ~700–1500 by frequency of Portuguese

vocabulary.note: Often used for unexpected events or problems.
Refers to the shipping process or the package.
In this context: 'to ask for something'.
Often used for income or receiving shipments.
Also 'too late' in the sense of delay.
Often used as an adjective, but here as a noun.

dialogue.speaker: Kunde
dialogue.text: Olá, preciso de ajuda. O meu envio #4321 não chegou e já paguei o total.
dialogue.translation: Hello, I need help. My shipment #4321 hasn't arrived and I've already paid the total amount.

dialogue.speaker: Mitarbeiter
dialogue.text: Lamento. Pode verificar o número do pedido novamente?
dialogue.translation: I'm sorry. Could you check the order number again?

dialogue.speaker: Kunde
dialogue.text: Sim, é o mesmo número. Mas recebi uma mensagem que o pacote foi entregue, e isso não aconteceu.
dialogue.translation: Yes, it's the same number. But I received a message that the package was delivered, and that didn't happen.

dialogue.speaker: Mitarbeiter
dialogue.text: Entendo. Talvez tenha havido um erro no sistema. Vou pedir ao transportador para investigar.
dialogue.translation: I understand. Maybe there was an error in the system. I'll ask the courier to investigate.

dialogue.speaker: Kunde
dialogue.text: Obrigado. Mas também me cobraram uma taxa adicional que não esperava.
dialogue.translation: Thank you. But they also charged me an additional fee that I didn't expect.

dialogue.speaker: Mitarbeiter
dialogue.text: Peço desculpa pelo incómodo. Vou verificar a sua conta e depois dou-lhe uma solução ainda hoje.
dialogue.translation: I apologize for the inconvenience. I'll check your account and then give you a solution later today.

dialogue.speaker: Kunde
dialogue.text: Espero que sim, porque já estou cansado de esperar.
dialogue.translation: I hope so, because I'm already tired of waiting.

scenario: Talking about ambitions and career goals
frequency_note: words ranked ~700–1500 by frequency of Portuguese

vocabulary.note: Feminine; often used for professional path.
With 'que' + subjunctive in the subordinate clause.
Feminine; often used for field of expertise.
Common adverb; position usually after the verb.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: O meu próximo objetivo é conseguir uma posição melhor na minha área.
dialogue.translation: My next goal is to achieve a better position in my field.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Que tipo de posição esperas alcançar na empresa?
dialogue.translation: What kind of position do you hope to achieve in the company?

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Sinto que tenho talento para liderar projetos, por isso quero ser chefe de equipa.
dialogue.translation: I feel that I have talent for leading projects, so I want to be team leader.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Sempre trabalhaste sobre tecnologia? Ou mudaste de área?
dialogue.translation: Have you always worked in technology? Or did you change fields?

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Sempre trabalhei em tecnologia, mas agora quero focar-me mais na gestão.
dialogue.translation: I have always worked in technology, but now I want to focus more on management.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Então, o teu objetivo final é dirigir um departamento?
dialogue.translation: So, your final goal is to manage a department?

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Sim, espero conseguir isso nos próximos cinco anos e sentir-me realizado na carreira.
dialogue.translation: Yes, I hope to achieve that in the next five years and feel fulfilled in my career.

scenario: Discussing health habits and lifestyle
frequency_note: words ranked ~700–1500 by frequency of Portuguese

vocabulary.note: Feminine; often in fixed expressions like 'ter saúde' (to be healthy)
Masculine; 'fazer bem ao corpo' = to be good for the body

vocabulary.translation: to manage, to achieve, to get
vocabulary.note: Irregular; often with infinitive: 'consigo dormir' = I can manage to sleep

vocabulary.translation: to usually do, to be accustomed to

vocabulary.note: Connector for consequence; at the beginning or middle of a sentence

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Você costuma fazer exercício regularmente? Eu ando tão cansado ultimamente.
dialogue.translation: Do you usually exercise regularly? I've been so tired lately.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Sim, tento ir ao ginásio três vezes por semana, mas nem sempre consigo. A minha alimentação também não é muito boa.
dialogue.translation: Yes, I try to go to the gym three times a week, but I don't always manage. My diet isn't very good either.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Eu percebo. Eu também como mal. Por isso, estou a tentar mudar os meus hábitos, especialmente dormir mais cedo.
dialogue.translation: I understand. I also eat badly. That's why I'm trying to change my habits, especially sleeping earlier.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Dormir cedo faz mesmo bem ao corpo. Eu sinto-me muito melhor quando durmo oito horas.
dialogue.translation: Sleeping early is really good for the body. I feel much better when I sleep eight hours.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Pois, mas eu tenho muito trabalho e à noite é o único tempo para relaxar. Isso afeta a minha vida social.
dialogue.translation: Yeah, but I have a lot of work and at night is the only time to relax. That affects my social life.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Talvez pudesses tentar fazer exercício de manhã. Assim, já não ficas tão cansado à noite e tens mais energia.
dialogue.translation: Maybe you could try exercising in the morning. That way, you won't be so tired at night and you'll have more energy.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: É uma boa ideia. Vou tentar acordar mais cedo e fazer exercício antes do trabalho. A saúde deve ser a prioridade.
dialogue.translation: That's a good idea. I'll try to wake up earlier and exercise before work. Health should be the priority.

key_phrases.translation: to be good for the body

scenario: Describing a recent trip in detail
frequency_note: words ranked ~700–1500 by frequency of Portuguese

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Oi! Você viajou no feriado?
dialogue.translation: Hi! Did you travel on the holiday?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Sim, fui para a praia. Cheguei lá na sexta-feira e saí para caminhar logo depois.
dialogue.translation: Yes, I went to the beach. I arrived there on Friday and went out for a walk right after.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Que bom! E como era o lugar?
dialogue.translation: How nice! And what was the place like?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: O lugar era ótimo, mas havia muita gente. Por isso, tive que esperar muito tempo para almoçar.
dialogue.translation: The place was great, but there were a lot of people. That's why I had to wait a long time to have lunch.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Entendi. E o que você fez antes de voltar?
dialogue.translation: I see. And what did you do before going back?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Antes de voltar, visitei um museu pequeno, porque queria conhecer a história local.
dialogue.translation: Before going back, I visited a small museum because I wanted to learn about the local history.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Parece que foi uma viagem muito boa!
dialogue.translation: Sounds like it was a very good trip!

scenario: Talking about environmental issues
frequency_note: words ranked ~700–1500 by frequency of Portuguese

vocabulary.note: Common in environmental contexts: 'causar danos' = to cause damage.

vocabulary.translation: to increase, to raise, to grow

vocabulary.note: With subjunctive: 'talvez seja' = maybe it is.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: O aumento da poluição nas cidades é um problema principal que precisamos resolver.
dialogue.translation: The increase in pollution in cities is a main problem that we need to solve.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Sim, os carros causam muita poluição. Talvez devêssemos usar mais transportes públicos.
dialogue.translation: Yes, cars cause a lot of pollution. Maybe we should use public transportation more.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Concordo, mas também é necessário reduzir o consumo de energia em casa.
dialogue.translation: I agree, but it is also necessary to reduce energy consumption at home.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: E proteger a natureza é essencial para o futuro. Você já participou em alguma ação ecológica?
dialogue.translation: And protecting nature is essential for the future. Have you ever participated in any ecological action?

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Sim, no ano passado plantamos árvores numa área perto do rio. Foi muito bom para o meio ambiente.
dialogue.translation: Yes, last year we planted trees in an area near the river. It was very good for the environment.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Que ótimo! Acho que cada pequena ação ajuda a reduzir os problemas ambientais.
dialogue.translation: How great! I think every small action helps to reduce environmental problems.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: É verdade, mas ainda há muito a fazer. Talvez devêssemos conversar com mais pessoas sobre isso.
dialogue.translation: That's true, but there is still much to do. Maybe we should talk to more people about it.

scenario: Discussing a decision you had to make
frequency_note: words ranked ~700–1500 by frequency of Portuguese

vocabulary.note: Often used with 'decidir + infinitive' or 'decidir-se por'
Feminine, also in the sense of 'decision'
Introduces a subordinate clause, often with subjunctive

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Lembra quando tive que decidir entre ficar na empresa ou mudar para o exterior?
dialogue.translation: Remember when I had to decide between staying in the company or moving abroad?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Sim, foi um momento difícil para ti, não foi?
dialogue.translation: Yes, that was a difficult moment for you, wasn't it?

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Pois foi. Por um lado, a nova opção parecia ótima, mas por outro, eu tinha medo de deixar tudo para trás.
dialogue.translation: Yes, it was. On one hand, the new option seemed great, but on the other, I was afraid of leaving everything behind.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Entendo. E como conseguiste ter certeza de que era a escolha certa?
dialogue.translation: I understand. And how did you manage to be sure it was the right choice?

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Passei semanas a pensar nisso, mas percebi que nenhuma decisão é fácil quando envolve risco.
dialogue.translation: I spent weeks thinking about it, but I realized that no decision is easy when it involves risk.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Embora fosse arriscado, no fundo sabias o que querias, certo?
dialogue.translation: Although it was risky, deep down you knew what you wanted, right?

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Sim, e quando finalmente decidi, tentei não olhar para trás. E até hoje acho que foi a melhor decisão.
dialogue.translation: Yes, and when I finally decided, I tried not to look back. And to this day I think it was the best decision.

scenario: Explaining why you changed your mind
frequency_note: words ranked ~700–1500 by frequency of Portuguese

vocabulary.note: Here in the sense of 'to change one's mind'.
In this context: 'a razão' = the reason.
Often used as a filler or to draw a conclusion.
More formal than 'mas', common in written and spoken language.
Agrees in gender and number: novo/nova/novos/novas.
Was listed as avoidable in the list, but here it's a key word in the dialogue – please ignore? – No, please ignore, I included it by mistake. I'll replace it with 'assim'.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Antes eu não gostava de trabalhar em casa, mas mudei de opinião.
dialogue.translation: Before, I didn't like working from home, but I changed my mind.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Então, qual foi a razão para essa mudança?
dialogue.translation: So, what was the reason for this change?

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Porém, depois de ver os novos dados sobre produtividade, percebi que estava errado.
dialogue.translation: However, after seeing the new data on productivity, I realized I was wrong.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Que fato te convenceu?
dialogue.translation: What fact convinced you?

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: O fato de que as pessoas são mais focadas em casa, e ainda conseguem fazer mais.
dialogue.translation: The fact that people are more focused at home, and still manage to do more.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Entendo. E você pretende continuar assim?
dialogue.translation: I see. And do you intend to continue like this?

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Sim, por isso vou explicar isso ao meu chefe amanhã.
dialogue.translation: Yes, that's why I'm going to explain this to my boss tomorrow.

scenario: Talking about cultural differences
frequency_note: words ranked ~700–1500 by frequency of Portuguese

vocabulary.note: Often used in discussions about customs and values.
Refers to social actions and reactions.
Often used to describe a realization or observation.
Important in the context of tolerance and intercultural understanding.
Singular: 'costume', plural: 'costumes' – not to be confused with 'Tracht'.
Can be used as an adjective or a noun.
Common in relative statements about cultural norms.

vocabulary.translation: to find strange, to be surprised

vocabulary.note: Refers to social interaction and community.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: No início, estranhei alguns costumes locais, mas agora percebo que são parte da cultura.
dialogue.translation: At first, I found some local customs strange, but now I realize they are part of the culture.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Que comportamento te pareceu mais estranho?
dialogue.translation: Which behavior seemed strangest to you?

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: O jeito como as pessoas se cumprimentam com beijos no rosto – para mim, isso não é normal.
dialogue.translation: The way people greet each other with kisses on the cheek – for me, that is not normal.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Entendo. Mas é importante respeitar essa diferença, mesmo que você estranhe no começo.
dialogue.translation: I understand. But it is important to respect this difference, even if you find it strange at first.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Sim, e com o tempo, comecei a gostar desse convívio mais próximo.
dialogue.translation: Yes, and over time, I started to enjoy this closer togetherness.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Isso acontece quando você se abre para o que é estrangeiro – o que parece estranho vira parte do seu dia a dia.
dialogue.translation: That happens when you open yourself to what is foreign – what seems strange becomes part of your daily life.

scenario: Discussing technology in daily life
frequency_note: words ranked ~700–1500 by frequency of Portuguese

vocabulary.note: Commonly used for the use of technology.
Often used for phone or computer screens.
The short form 'app' is also used.
Often used for devices or systems.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Você geralmente usa muitos aplicativos no trabalho?
dialogue.translation: Do you usually use many apps at work?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Sim, mas às vezes a conexão é lenta e isso me atrapalha.
dialogue.translation: Yes, but sometimes the connection is slow and that bothers me.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Aqui também. Mas quando a internet é rápida, tudo funciona melhor.
dialogue.translation: Here too. But when the internet is fast, everything works better.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Eu preciso de uma tela maior para ver os detalhes dos projetos.
dialogue.translation: I need a bigger screen to see the details of the projects.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Concordo. Sobre isso, você já tentou usar um monitor externo?
dialogue.translation: I agree. Regarding that, have you tried using an external monitor?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Ainda não, mas acho que vai ajudar muito.
dialogue.translation: Not yet, but I think it will help a lot.

scenario: At a formal meeting giving your opinion
frequency_note: words ranked ~700–1500 by frequency of Portuguese

vocabulary.note: used to express opinion: 'acredito que' = 'I believe that'

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Bom dia a todos. Nesta reunião, gostaria de ouvir a vossa opinião sobre a proposta que enviei.
dialogue.translation: Good morning everyone. In this meeting, I would like to hear your opinion on the proposal I sent.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Obrigado. Eu acredito que a proposta é boa, mas temos de considerar o impacto no orçamento.
dialogue.translation: Thank you. I believe the proposal is good, but we have to consider the impact on the budget.

dialogue.speaker: C
dialogue.text: Entretanto, não concordo totalmente. Precisamos de mais dados antes de decidir.
dialogue.translation: However, I don't fully agree. We need more data before deciding.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Entendido. Que ponto específico lhe preocupa, senhor C?
dialogue.translation: Understood. What specific point concerns you, Mr. C?

dialogue.speaker: C
dialogue.text: O ponto principal é o prazo. Conforme o cronograma atual, será difícil concluir a tempo.
dialogue.translation: The main point is the deadline. According to the current schedule, it will be difficult to finish on time.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Sugiro que ajustemos o cronograma. O objetivo principal é entregar com qualidade, não apenas rápido.
dialogue.translation: I suggest we adjust the schedule. The main objective is to deliver with quality, not just quickly.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Então, se todos concordam, vamos considerar essa alteração e concluir a reunião com um plano atualizado.
dialogue.translation: Then, if everyone agrees, we will consider this change and conclude the meeting with an updated plan.

scenario: Describing a person's character in depth
frequency_note: words ranked ~700–1500 by frequency of Portuguese

vocabulary.note: Used to describe a person's overall personality or moral character.
Refers to a positive trait or characteristic of a person.
Used for negative traits or flaws in character.
Describes a person who tells the truth and is sincere.
Describes someone who gives freely and is kind.
Describes a person who can wait calmly or endure difficulties.
Can have positive (self-respect) or negative (arrogant) connotations depending on context.
Emphasizes honesty and genuineness in speech and behavior.
Refers to a person's general approach or demeanor.
Used in expressions like 'senso de humor' (sense of humor) or 'senso de responsabilidade' (sense of responsibility).
Describes a person who can be trusted and relied upon.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: O que você acha do caráter do novo colega?
dialogue.translation: What do you think of the new colleague's character?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Acho que ele tem muitas qualidades: é honesto, generoso e muito paciente com os outros.
dialogue.translation: I think he has many good qualities: he is honest, generous, and very patient with others.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Sim, mas também tem defeitos. Às vezes é um pouco orgulhoso e não aceita críticas.
dialogue.translation: Yes, but he also has flaws. Sometimes he is a bit proud and doesn't accept criticism.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Concordo, mas acho que ele é sincero e tem uma atitude positiva no trabalho.
dialogue.translation: I agree, but I think he is sincere and has a positive attitude at work.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: E tem um ótimo senso de humor, além de ser muito confiável.
dialogue.translation: And he has a great sense of humor, besides being very reliable.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Então, apesar dos defeitos, ele parece ser uma boa pessoa no geral.
dialogue.translation: So, despite the flaws, he seems to be a good person overall.

scenario: Talking about education and learning
frequency_note: words ranked ~700–1500 by frequency of Portuguese

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Você está gostando do curso de português?
dialogue.translation: Are you enjoying the Portuguese course?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Sim, mas a matéria de gramática é um pouco difícil. A professora ensina bem, porém.
dialogue.translation: Yes, but the grammar subject is a bit difficult. The teacher teaches well, though.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Que bom! Eu também quero aprender mais vocabulário. Você já fez a prova do mês?
dialogue.translation: Great! I also want to learn more vocabulary. Have you already taken the monthly exam?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Ainda não, mas estudei bastante. Espero tirar uma boa nota, porque me esforcei muito.
dialogue.translation: Not yet, but I studied a lot. I hope to get a good grade, because I tried hard.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Para mim, o mais importante é o conhecimento, não só a nota. Mas sei que o esforço vale a pena.
dialogue.translation: For me, knowledge is the most important thing, not just the grade. But I know the effort is worth it.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Concordo. Preciso praticar mais conversação para melhorar minha fluência.
dialogue.translation: I agree. I need to practice conversation more to improve my fluency.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Vamos fazer um intercâmbio juntos? Assim a gente aprende na prática!
dialogue.translation: Let's do an exchange together? That way we learn in practice!

scenario: Discussing a problem and offering solutions
frequency_note: words ranked ~700–1500 by frequency of Portuguese

vocabulary.note: Masculine, but in Portuguese it ends in -a; plural: problemas
Feminine; often used with 'encontrar uma solução'
Same form for masculine and feminine

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Preciso falar contigo sobre um problema que aconteceu no trabalho.
dialogue.translation: I need to talk to you about a problem that happened at work.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Claro, explica-me melhor. Qual é a causa?
dialogue.translation: Sure, explain it to me better. What is the cause?

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: O efeito foi que perdemos um cliente importante, talvez por causa de um erro nosso.
dialogue.translation: The effect was that we lost an important client, perhaps because of a mistake of ours.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Entendo. É possível tentar uma solução simples?
dialogue.translation: I understand. Is it possible to try a simple solution?

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Sim, podemos mudar a nossa abordagem e explicar melhor ao cliente.
dialogue.translation: Yes, we can change our approach and explain better to the client.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Boa ideia. Talvez isso resolva o problema e evite efeitos negativos.
dialogue.translation: Good idea. Maybe that will solve the problem and avoid negative effects.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Vou tentar isso e depois falamos sobre a solução final.
dialogue.translation: I will try that and then we'll talk about the final solution.

scenario: Comparing two options for a trip
frequency_note: words ranked ~700–1500 by frequency of Portuguese

vocabulary.note: Usually in the singular 'custo' or plural 'custos'.
Regular -ar verb: eu gasto, nós gastamos.
Introduces a subordinate clause, often with subjunctive.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Para a nossa viagem, temos duas opções: uma praia perto daqui e uma cidade longe, mas com muitas atrações.
dialogue.translation: For our trip, we have two options: a beach nearby and a city far away, but with many attractions.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Qual é a diferença de custo? Eu prefiro gastar menos, embora a cidade seja mais interessante.
dialogue.translation: What is the cost difference? I prefer to spend less, although the city is more interesting.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: A praia é mais barata, mas a viagem de ônibus é cara. Já a cidade é mais cara, mas podemos economizar na hospedagem.
dialogue.translation: The beach is cheaper, but the bus trip is expensive. The city, on the other hand, is more expensive, but we can save on accommodation.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Talvez seja melhor escolher a praia, pois o custo total será menor e ficamos mais perto da natureza.
dialogue.translation: Maybe it's better to choose the beach, because the total cost will be lower and we'll be closer to nature.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Mas se formos para a cidade, podemos visitar museus e restaurantes, mesmo que fique mais caro no final.
dialogue.translation: But if we go to the city, we can visit museums and restaurants, even if it ends up more expensive.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Eu prefiro economizar agora e gastar em lembranças, então a praia é a melhor opção.
dialogue.translation: I prefer to save now and spend on souvenirs, so the beach is the best option.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Concordo, embora eu ainda ache a cidade atraente, talvez no próximo ano façamos essa viagem mais longe.
dialogue.translation: I agree, although I still find the city attractive; maybe next year we'll take that trip farther away.

scenario: Talking about social media habits
frequency_note: words ranked ~700–1500 by frequency of Portuguese

vocabulary.note: Commonly used in reference to online platforms
Informal but very common in social media
Also possible as preposition 'according to', here it is an adjective
Very versatile, also used as a filler word
Also possible 'to continue', here in the context of social media
Formal, but normal in digital context

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Você acessa suas redes sociais todos os dias?
dialogue.translation: Do you access your social networks every day?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Sim, mas eu tento limitar o tempo que passo no meu perfil.
dialogue.translation: Yes, but I try to limit the time I spend on my profile.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Que tipo de conteúdo você costuma curtir ou compartilhar?
dialogue.translation: What kind of content do you usually like or share?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Principalmente notícias e fotos de amigos. Mas eu não gosto de postar muita coisa pessoal.
dialogue.translation: Mainly news and photos of friends. But I don't like to post too much personal stuff.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Eu sigo muitos perfis de tecnologia. No meu segundo perfil, só sigo contas de humor.
dialogue.translation: I follow many technology profiles. On my second profile, I only follow humor accounts.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Interessante. Você acha que o usuário médio passa tempo demais nas redes?
dialogue.translation: Interesting. Do you think the average user spends too much time on social networks?

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Com certeza, mas é difícil mudar esse hábito, não é?
dialogue.translation: Definitely, but it's hard to change that habit, isn't it?

scenario: Giving a short presentation at work
frequency_note: words ranked ~700–1500 by frequency of Portuguese

vocabulary.note: commonly used for presentations and introductions

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Bom dia a todos. Hoje vou apresentar os dados do último trimestre.
dialogue.translation: Good morning everyone. Today I will present the data from the last quarter.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Ótimo. Você vai mostrar o gráfico de aumento das vendas?
dialogue.translation: Great. Will you show the chart of sales increase?

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Sim, primeiro mostro o gráfico e depois explico o resultado no mercado atual.
dialogue.translation: Yes, first I show the chart and then I explain the result in the current market.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: E qual é a principal conclusão para a nossa equipe?
dialogue.translation: And what is the main conclusion for our team?

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: A principal conclusão é que o aumento foi maior que o esperado, graças ao esforço de todos.
dialogue.translation: The main conclusion is that the increase was greater than expected, thanks to everyone's effort.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Entendi. E qual será o próximo passo do projeto?
dialogue.translation: I see. And what will be the next step of the project?

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Finalmente, vamos planejar o próximo trimestre e definir novas metas para a equipe.
dialogue.translation: Finally, we will plan the next quarter and set new goals for the team.

scenario: Discussing a sport or hobby you follow
frequency_note: words ranked ~700–1500 by frequency of Portuguese

vocabulary.note: Often used with 'a' when meaning 'to watch' (assistir a).
As adjective: 'favorito' (favorite); as noun: 'o favorito' (the favorite).
In sports context, 'partida' is a match/game.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Você assistiu à partida de ontem? O nosso clube perdeu de novo.
dialogue.translation: Did you watch the match yesterday? Our club lost again.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Não vi, mas ouvi que foi um empate, não uma derrota. O jogador principal marcou no final.
dialogue.translation: I didn't see it, but I heard it was a tie, not a defeat. The main player scored at the end.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Que bom! Mas ainda estamos longe do primeiro lugar no campeonato. O time favorito venceu todos os jogos.
dialogue.translation: That's good! But we're still far from first place in the championship. The favorite team won all the games.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: É verdade. Mas o esporte é assim: às vezes você ganha, às vezes perde. O importante é continuar torcendo.
dialogue.translation: That's true. But sport is like that: sometimes you win, sometimes you lose. The important thing is to keep cheering.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Concordo. E no próximo domingo temos outra partida contra o rival. Você vai assistir?
dialogue.translation: I agree. And next Sunday we have another match against the rival. Are you going to watch?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Claro! Vou ver com meus amigos. Se vencermos, podemos subir na tabela.
dialogue.translation: Of course! I'll watch with my friends. If we win, we can move up in the standings.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Tomara! Mas não esquece que o nosso clube não vence fora de casa há meses.
dialogue.translation: Hopefully! But don't forget that our club hasn't won away from home in months.
